cached_title: Your copy is on this device
error_boot: The engine could not start. Reload the page to try again.
error_not_balatro: That file is a LÖVE game, but not Balatro.
error_not_zip: That file has no game inside. Pick Balatro.exe or Balatro.love.
error_webgl: This browser has WebGL turned off, and the game needs it to draw.
how_1: Balatro.exe is the LÖVE engine with the game zipped onto its end. The page finds the zip in the file and unpacks it in memory.
how_2: The engine is LÖVE 11 compiled to WebAssembly with Emscripten (love.js). The Windows DLLs are never used: they are x86 code.
how_3: A small Lua layer runs first. It turns the game’s threads into coroutines and adds LuaJIT’s bit library and random generator, so seeds deal the same cards as on desktop.
how_4: The save folder is mounted on IndexedDB and flushed after every save. Steam is not available, so achievements are tracked locally.
import_empty: No Balatro saves (.jkr files) in that zip.
import_failed: That file is not a zip.
intro: Play your own copy of Balatro in the browser. Pick the game file from your install; it is read on this device and never uploaded.
keep_copy: Keep the game on this device so it opens without picking it again
title: Balatro
where_mac: macOS: Balatro.app → Show Package Contents → Contents/Resources/Balatro.love.
where_saves: Saves stay in this browser. Use the export and import buttons in the game to move them to or from %AppData%\Balatro.
where_windows: Windows: in Steam, right-click Balatro → Manage → Browse local files → Balatro.exe.
